title: Tech View's Assigned Techs column sits right after Lines
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 1 user · 1 browser · about 10 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043). Desktop browser window at least 1024 px wide (narrower windows show only the List, without the display switcher).
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On a QA branch sign in with the Admin quick-login button on the sign-in page; you appear as "Admin ShopView". The Admin role holds Work orders > View and Work orders > Create & Edit (to check: your initials at the top right > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > Work orders).
  • Location: one location for the whole case, shown in the top bar next to the bell (e.g. "Staging Heavy Duty - 9919"); to change it click your initials at the top right > Change Location.
  • Technician: 1 eligible technician at this location to lead the work order (e.g. "Esther Howard"), recorded as [Tech-A]. A technician is eligible when Time Clock is on, the staff member is active (not deactivated), the Role is neither Office User nor Time Clock User, and this location is picked in their Location field.
  • Customer "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Assigned Techs Column" (used by this case only), with one contact and one asset.
  • Work order [WO-1] for this customer: status Approved, Lead Technician [Tech-A].
  • Tech View Column Selection: Assigned Techs may start on or off (step 3 reads it). Names and numbers are examples.

Setup

  1. Settings (your initials at the top right > Settings) > Staff: confirm each technician below exists and is eligible, or add them with New Staff Member: First Name and Last Name (e.g. "Esther Howard"; record as [Tech-A]) and an email; a Role that is not Office User or Time Clock User (e.g. "Technician"); at least one Department (required); Location = this location; Time Clock on > Save & Close.
  2. Top menu Customers > New Customer, Name "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Assigned Techs Column" > Save (skip if it already exists). On the customer page click the Contacts tab > New Contact > First Name and Last Name > Save (a new asset needs a contact). Then click the Assets tab > New Asset > pick the Contact, then Year, Make, Model and Unit (e.g. 2022, Freightliner, M2, unit "TRK-118") > Save. Make is required; Unit can be left empty. Record the customer as [Cust-1].
  3. Create the work order: Work Orders > Create Work Order > in the New Work Order window pick Customer [Cust-1] and its Asset > Save, and write down its number as [WO-1] (e.g. "S1-702"). The new work order opens with the New Line form (otherwise click New Line on the Lines tab): in "What Are You Doing?" pick a ready-made line (e.g. "Replace - Brake pot"; typed free text finds no results), turn on Line Approved and click Save & Close, so the work order status reads Approved (or use the line's approve control on the Lines tab).
  4. Once the work order is Approved, pick [Tech-A] in the Lead Technician dropdown on the work order page. (While a work order is an Estimate its Lead technician is read-only on the work order page; give an Estimate its lead from Board View instead: the card's More actions (…) > Reassign lead technician > pick the technician > Reassign.)
  5. Check the setup worked: Work Orders > All tab > List > type "ZZAUTOTEST F3 Assigned Techs Column" in Search — exactly [WO-1] shows, Approved, Lead Technician [Tech-A]. If it does not match, fix the work order (or create it again) before starting.
custom_steps:
1. Open Work Orders, click the All tab and pick Tech View in the display switcher (tooltip "Tech View").
  2. Type [Cust-1] ("ZZAUTOTEST F3 Assigned Techs Column") in Search.
  3. Open the Column Selection menu and read whether Assigned Techs is on.
  4. Turn Lines on if it is off, then turn Assigned Techs on.
  5. Read which column is directly to the right of Lines.
  6. Turn Assigned Techs off again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Assigned Techs is optional: it is added from the column chooser and can be turned off again.
  • When on, the Assigned Techs column is immediately after Lines, as in the design.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10043; story SV-10050 (Story 7, Show line technicians on cards and rows); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S7-R7, read 8 Oct 2026. PO answer Chris Ward 2 Oct 2026 thread ("right after Lines"). Design export of 8 Oct 2026 (Claude Design project 787fef1a, Work Orders.dc.html): Tech View column order … Lines, Assigned Tech, Created on, Total price. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S7-R7: “In Tech View the Assigned Techs column sits immediately after Lines, matching the design. It stays optional and is added through the column chooser (S2-R4).”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
